\begin{lexlean}{Uorc.Codec.Archive}
\importmodule{Uorc.Codec.LzDecode}
\importmodule{Uorc.Codec.LzEncode}
\importmodule{Uorc.Integrity.Sha256}
\title{Parameters}
\begin{semanticmodule}
definition{
  name: kernelPrefix,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bytes,
  body: ,
  executable: true,
  axioms: []
}

definition{
  name: kernelSuffix,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bytes,
  body: ,
  executable: true,
  axioms: []
}

definition{
  name: cat,
  parameters: [a : Bytes, b : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append a b : Bytes),
  executable: true,
  axioms: []
}

definition{
  name: uleb,
  parameters: [fuel : Nat, n : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => 0x
    | Nat.succ k => (if (n <? 128) then (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::singleton n) else (cat (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::singleton ((prim remainder n 128 0 : Nat) + 128)) (uleb k (prim quotient n 128 0 : Nat))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: number,
  parameters: [n : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (uleb 10 n),
  executable: true,
  axioms: []
}

definition{
  name: preimage,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes, n : Nat, body : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (cat (cat (cat (cat (cat 0x554f5243020100 kind) (number 1)) (number n)) (number (prim length body : Nat))) body),
  executable: true,
  axioms: []
}

definition{
  name: chainLoop,
  parameters: [fuel : Nat, data : Bytes, at : Nat, c : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Nat.succ k => (let rest : Nat := (prim subtract (prim length data : Nat) at : Nat); (if (64 <=? rest) then (match (prim slice data at 64 : (Option Bytes))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some chunk => (match (Uorc.Integrity.Sha256::hash (cat (cat (cat 0x554f52432d5348413235362d434841494e2d763100 0x01) c) chunk))
        | Result.error failure => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
        | Result.ok h => (chainLoop k data (at + 64) h))) else (match (prim slice data at rest : (Option Bytes))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some tail => (match (Uorc.Integrity.Sha256::hash (cat (cat (cat (cat 0x554f52432d5348413235362d434841494e2d763100 0x02) c) (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::singleton rest)) tail))
        | Result.error failure => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
        | Result.ok h => (ctor Option.some [Bytes] h)))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: seal,
  parameters: [pre : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (Uorc.Integrity.Sha256::hash (cat 0x554f52432d5348413235362d434841494e2d763100 0x00))
    | Result.error failure => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Result.ok c => (match (chainLoop ((prim quotient (prim length pre : Nat) 64 0 : Nat) + 1) pre 0 c)
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some d => (ctor Option.some [Bytes] (cat pre d)))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: programArchive,
  parameters: [n : Nat, payload : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (seal (preimage 0x01 n (cat (cat (cat (kernelPrefix) (number (prim length payload : Nat))) payload) (kernelSuffix)))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: rawArchive,
  parameters: [input : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (seal (preimage 0x00 (prim length input : Nat) input)),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: archive,
  parameters: [input : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (programArchive (prim length input : Nat) (Uorc.Codec.LzEncode::encode input)),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: readUleb,
  parameters: [fuel : Nat, data : Bytes, at : Nat, weight : Nat, acc : Nat],
  result: (Option (Nat * Nat)),
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
    | Nat.succ k => (match (prim index data at : (Option UInt8))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
      | Option.some octet => (let b : Nat := (prim to_nat octet : Nat); (if (b <? 128) then (ctor Option.some [(Nat * Nat)] ((acc + (prim multiply weight b : Nat)), (at + 1))) else (readUleb k data (at + 1) (prim multiply 128 weight : Nat) (acc + (prim multiply weight (prim subtract b 128 : Nat) : Nat))))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: payloadAt,
  parameters: [data : Bytes, at : Nat],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (readUleb 10 data at 1 0)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some r => (prim slice data (second r) (first r) : (Option Bytes))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: lengthAt,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option (Nat * Nat)),
  body: (match (readUleb 10 data 9 1 0)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
    | Option.some n => (match (readUleb 10 data (second n) 1 0)
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
      | Option.some b => (ctor Option.some [(Nat * Nat)] ((first n), ((second b) + (prim length (kernelPrefix) : Nat)))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: kernelPayload,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option (Nat * Bytes)),
  body: (match (lengthAt data)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Bytes)])
    | Option.some np => (match (payloadAt data (second np))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Bytes)])
      | Option.some payload => (match (programArchive (first np) payload)
        | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Bytes)])
        | Option.some rebuilt => (if (prim equal rebuilt data : Bool) then (ctor Option.some [(Nat * Bytes)] ((first np), payload)) else (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Bytes)]))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: rawPayload,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (readUleb 10 data 9 1 0)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some n => (match (readUleb 10 data (second n) 1 0)
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some b => (match (prim slice data (second b) (first n) : (Option Bytes))
        | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
        | Option.some payload => (match (rawArchive payload)
          | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
          | Option.some rebuilt => (if (prim equal rebuilt data : Bool) then (ctor Option.some [Bytes] payload) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes])))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: kernelDecode,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (kernelPayload data)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some np => (let payload : Bytes := (second np); (let out : Bytes := (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::decode payload); (if (((prim length out : Nat) =? (first np)) && (prim equal (Uorc.Codec.LzEncode::encode out) payload : Bool)) then (ctor Option.some [Bytes] out) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: fastDecode,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (prim index data 7 : (Option UInt8))
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some kind => (if ((prim to_nat kind : Nat) =? 0) then (rawPayload data) else (kernelDecode data))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
\end{semanticmodule}
\end{lexlean}
